ios.desc:
Taking medication consistently matters.
Lumo helps you stay on track.

Lumo is a medication reminder app designed to help you build consistency with the medications and supplements that support your health. Set reminders, stay accountable, and create routines that actually stick.

In addition to reminders, Lumo helps you better understand your health data by organizing and explaining blood test results in a clear, calm way — so you can notice changes over time and have more informed conversations with your doctor.

Lumo is built for people who take their health seriously.
Not with pressure or fear — but with clarity and consistency.

What Lumo helps you do:

Set reliable medication and supplement reminders

Build daily consistency and reduce missed doses

Understand blood test results in plain language

Track trends across past lab reports

Prepare better questions for your healthcare provider

Lumo does not replace medical care.
It helps you stay informed and consistent.

Health, supported - day by day.

Medical Disclaimer

Lumo is not a medical device and does not provide medical diagnoses, treatment, or clinical advice. Medication reminders and blood test explanations are for informational and organizational purposes only and are not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always seek the advice of a qualified healthcare provider before starting, stopping, or changing any medication or making medical decisions.

Privacy & Data

Lumo does not sell personal data. Health information, reminders, and uploaded lab reports are stored securely and used only to provide functionality within the app. You can delete your account and data at any time.
